parameters.question: The target reference image needed for this viewpoint-matching task is missing from my visual evidence: the camera packet lists current_view (scene_primary) and target_view (scene_secondary), but only the current_scene frame (dark refrigeration unit on the left, dark tiled wall with a framed picture on the right) was delivered. Please provide the target_view image (or its camera pose: position and yaw/pitch relative to the current camera). Alternatively, confirm that I should explore the scene blindly with single-step viewpoint actions until I judge the view resembles the target.
parameters.missing_evidence: frame_id=target_view (role=scene_secondary) — goal image or its camera pose (translation + orientation) in the current frame.
parameters.proposed_actions_if_unavailable: Single atomic viewpoint actions with re-observation after each: e.g. RotateLeft to sweep the scene, comparing each new current_view against the target if it becomes available.
